pages.title: Nixflex API reference
pages.description: Explore the Nixflex API for voice agents, calls, numbers, SMS and knowledge. Find authentication, request fields, response shapes and examples.

pages.title: API authentication and permissions
pages.description: Authenticate Nixflex API requests with a server-side key. Understand account ownership, personal sessions and Owner, Admin and Member permissions.
pages.searchPhrase: api authentication and permissions Nixflex API

pages.title: API errors and status codes
pages.description: Find Nixflex API error codes, HTTP statuses and recovery steps. Distinguish invalid input, permission failures, temporary errors and uncertain results.
pages.searchPhrase: api errors and status codes Nixflex API

pages.title: API pagination and filters
pages.description: Page through Nixflex agents, calls, numbers and knowledge. Use each endpoint’s limit, offset or cursor without losing filters or assuming one list shape.
pages.searchPhrase: api pagination and filters Nixflex API

pages.title: API rate limits
pages.description: Handle Nixflex API rate limits using RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Keep request quotas separate from call capacity and feature limits.

pages.title: API idempotency
pages.description: Use Nixflex knowledge operation keys and revisions correctly. Learn which requests support replay and how to handle uncertain calls, SMS and other writes.

pages.title: Webhooks and signature verification
pages.description: Receive Nixflex call and booking events. Verify raw-body signatures, handle duplicate delivery and fetch private recording links when playback is needed.
pages.searchPhrase: webhooks and signature verification Nixflex API

pages.title: Retry failed API requests
pages.description: Choose safe retry behavior for Nixflex API reads and writes. Honor Retry-After, reconcile unknown outcomes and avoid duplicate calls, messages or purchases.
pages.searchPhrase: retry failed api requests Nixflex API

pages.title: API versions and compatibility
pages.description: Track Nixflex API compatibility, additive fields and retired routes. Preserve unknown values and confirm client support before changing a live integration.
pages.searchPhrase: api versions and compatibility Nixflex API

pages.title: Agent settings and defaults
pages.description: Understand Nixflex agent fields, defaults, limits and nullable values. Configure call behavior, prompts, keyterms, retention and supported channel settings.
pages.searchPhrase: agent settings and defaults Nixflex API

pages.title: Create an agent
pages.description: Create an AI phone agent with the Nixflex API. Check request fields, default call limits, responses and errors, with cURL, Node, Python and CLI examples.

pages.title: List agents
pages.description: List Nixflex agents owned by the account. Read their settings and use each agent ID for detail, update or disable requests.

pages.title: Get an agent
pages.description: Read one Nixflex agent and its saved settings. Check whether it is active before assigning numbers or starting calls.

pages.title: Update an agent
pages.description: Update selected settings on an owned Nixflex agent. The PUT request is partial: omitted fields keep their saved values.

pages.title: Delete an agent
pages.description: Disable an owned Nixflex agent. Understand the inactive state, retained record and checks before assigning numbers or starting calls.

pages.title: List phone numbers
pages.description: List phone numbers owned by the Nixflex account. Read assigned agents and saved number settings before routing or configuration changes.

pages.title: Get a phone number
pages.description: Read one owned Nixflex phone number, its assigned agent and saved settings. Use the encoded international number in the request path.
pages.searchPhrase: get a phone number Nixflex API

pages.title: Import a phone number
pages.description: Import a phone number you own into Nixflex and assign it to an active agent. Review existing routing before changing the number configuration.
pages.searchPhrase: import a phone number Nixflex API

pages.title: Update a phone number
pages.description: Update an owned Nixflex number's settings or move it to another active agent on the account. Review routing and uncertain outcomes before retrying.
pages.searchPhrase: update a phone number Nixflex API

pages.title: Get number usage
pages.description: Read usage for an owned Nixflex phone number. Check the response fields and account scope before using the totals in your application.

pages.title: Remove a phone number
pages.description: Disconnect an owned number from Nixflex and clear routing managed by its import. This does not release the number from your carrier account.
pages.searchPhrase: remove a phone number Nixflex API

pages.title: List calls
pages.description: List calls with the Nixflex API. Read the legacy call list as a bare array, newest creation time first. Use the history operation when you need filters.

pages.title: Get call history
pages.description: Get call history with the Nixflex API. Read a filtered call-history envelope with matching totals. History includes failed starts and omits transcripts.

pages.title: Get a call
pages.description: Get a call with the Nixflex API. Read one account-owned call. Use view=detail for the explicit nullable detail shape, failed-start IDs and retained metadata.

pages.title: Get a call recording
pages.description: Read Nixflex call recording status and obtain a fresh signed download link when available. Handle unavailable, pending and deleted recordings.
pages.searchPhrase: get a call recording Nixflex API

pages.title: Create an outbound call
pages.description: Start one Nixflex outbound call from an owned number assigned to an active agent. Handle policy refusals and uncertain results before another attempt.
pages.searchPhrase: create an outbound call Nixflex API

pages.title: Call outcomes and safe retries
pages.description: Handle Nixflex call starts, active calls, deletions and unknown outcomes. Use confirmed state before retrying actions or treating a call as completed.
pages.searchPhrase: call outcomes and safe retries Nixflex API

pages.title: Delete a call
pages.description: Delete an owned Nixflex call with guarded recording cleanup. Handle blocked or uncertain results without treating them as confirmed deletion.

pages.title: Delete all calls
pages.description: Request guarded deletion of Nixflex call data for the account. Review scope, cleanup requirements and uncertain outcomes before another request.

pages.title: List voice campaigns
pages.description: List voice campaigns with the Nixflex API. List this account’s voice campaigns, newest first. This bounded list has no offset or cursor.

pages.title: Create a voice campaign
pages.description: Create a Nixflex voice campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
pages.searchPhrase: create a voice campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Launch a voice campaign
pages.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex voice campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching calls.
pages.searchPhrase: launch a voice campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Cancel voice campaign
pages.description: Cancel voice campaign with the Nixflex API. Cancel future work for an owned voice campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.

pages.title: Resume voice campaign
pages.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex voice campaign. Review consent and current campaign state first.

pages.title: Record voice consent
pages.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex voice campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.

pages.title: Send an SMS
pages.description: Send one SMS through Nixflex using an explicit, owned sender assigned to the agent. Distinguish acceptance from delivery and handle uncertain results.

pages.title: List SMS campaigns
pages.description: List the account's Nixflex SMS campaigns, newest first. Delivery totals cover all campaign recipients, beyond the current recipient page.

pages.title: Create an SMS campaign
pages.description: Create a Nixflex SMS campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
pages.searchPhrase: create an sms campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Get an SMS campaign
pages.description: Get an SMS campaign with the Nixflex API. Read one owned SMS campaign with recipient and message history. The campaign counters cover the whole campaign.
pages.searchPhrase: get an sms campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Update SMS reply settings
pages.description: Update reply behaviour for an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. This request does not edit the campaign's recipients, schedule or outbound message.
pages.searchPhrase: update sms reply settings Nixflex API

pages.title: Launch an SMS campaign
pages.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching messages.
pages.searchPhrase: launch an sms campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Cancel SMS campaign
pages.description: Cancel SMS campaign with the Nixflex API. Cancel future work for an owned SMS campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.

pages.title: Resume SMS campaign
pages.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex SMS campaign. This can dispatch messages after policy checks.

pages.title: Record SMS consent
pages.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex SMS campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.

pages.title: Delete an SMS campaign
pages.description: Delete a settled Nixflex SMS campaign. Handle active-work conflicts, pending settlement and unknown results before removing it from your application.
pages.searchPhrase: delete an sms campaign Nixflex API

pages.title: Get knowledge capabilities
pages.description: Get knowledge capabilities with the Nixflex API. Read current knowledge limits, defaults and account scope marker.

pages.title: List knowledge agents
pages.description: List knowledge agents with the Nixflex API. List active owned agents and their live knowledge state.

pages.title: Get agent knowledge
pages.description: Get agent knowledge with the Nixflex API. Read the agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision.

pages.title: Set agent knowledge
pages.description: Set agent knowledge with the Nixflex API. Create the agent’s singleton knowledge base or update its settings.

pages.title: Get knowledge base
pages.description: Get knowledge base with the Nixflex API. Read a knowledge base’s settings, revision and active published index.

pages.title: Get knowledge overview
pages.description: Get knowledge overview with the Nixflex API. Read topic, token, publication, review and seven-day observation totals.

pages.title: Read automatic keyterms
pages.description: Read automatic keyterms with the Nixflex API. Read ranked automatic speech terms from an agent’s current live knowledge.

pages.title: Get knowledge usage
pages.description: Get knowledge usage with the Nixflex API. Read private storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters.

pages.title: Read knowledge events
pages.description: Read knowledge events with the Nixflex API. Read ordered owner-scoped knowledge events for reconciliation.

pages.title: Measure knowledge source
pages.description: Measure knowledge source with the Nixflex API. Preview source token usage before an import without storing the source.

pages.title: Import knowledge source
pages.description: Import knowledge source with the Nixflex API. Submit pasted text or a raw file and queue preparation of original-word pieces.

pages.title: List knowledge sources
pages.description: List knowledge sources with the Nixflex API. List accepted sources that still have unsuppressed live pieces.

pages.title: Rename knowledge source
pages.description: Rename knowledge source with the Nixflex API. Change a source name without changing facts or the published index.

pages.title: Replace knowledge source
pages.description: Replace knowledge source with the Nixflex API. Prepare replacement source text while preserving the accepted version until publication.

pages.title: Refresh website sources
pages.description: Refresh website sources with the Nixflex API. Refresh explicitly selected saved website sources.

pages.title: Delete knowledge source
pages.description: Delete knowledge source with the Nixflex API. Remove an accepted source with explicit confirmation of affected topics.

pages.title: Discover website pages
pages.description: Discover website pages with the Nixflex API. Discover selectable public pages without importing or publishing them.

pages.title: Import selected pages
pages.description: Import selected pages with the Nixflex API. Import only pages chosen from a completed owned website discovery.

pages.title: Get knowledge draft
pages.description: Get knowledge draft with the Nixflex API. Read proposed pieces, review flags, reminders and draft revision.

pages.title: Edit knowledge draft
pages.description: Edit knowledge draft with the Nixflex API. Edit one proposed piece while preserving evidence and review requirements.

pages.title: Accept knowledge draft
pages.description: Accept knowledge draft with the Nixflex API. Approve an explicit selection of reviewed pieces and queue publication.

pages.title: Discard knowledge draft
pages.description: Discard knowledge draft with the Nixflex API. Discard a review draft while retaining currently published knowledge.

pages.title: List knowledge topics
pages.description: List knowledge topics with the Nixflex API. List current pieces in their stable display order.

pages.title: Get knowledge topic
pages.description: Get knowledge topic with the Nixflex API. Read one current piece, its evidence and saved metadata.

pages.title: Create knowledge topic
pages.description: Create knowledge topic with the Nixflex API. Create a manually written piece and prepare a fresh index.

pages.title: Update knowledge topic
pages.description: Update knowledge topic with the Nixflex API. Correct a live piece and prepare its replacement index.

pages.title: Delete knowledge topic
pages.description: Delete knowledge topic with the Nixflex API. Remove a current piece and prevent source refresh from restoring it.

pages.title: Search knowledge topics
pages.description: Search knowledge topics with the Nixflex API. Find related current topics for knowledge management.

pages.title: List unanswered questions
pages.description: List unanswered questions with the Nixflex API. Read recent real questions from delivered turns without a retrieval match.

pages.title: Update knowledge settings
pages.description: Update knowledge settings with the Nixflex API. Change enabled channels, matching mode or the not-found sentence.

pages.title: Start knowledge test
pages.description: Start knowledge test with the Nixflex API. Start a knowledge-only simulated test session for an agent with live knowledge.

pages.title: Get knowledge test session
pages.description: Get knowledge test session with the Nixflex API. Read the saved knowledge-only conversation and its current state.
pages.searchPhrase: get knowledge test session Nixflex API

pages.title: Ask a knowledge test question
pages.description: Ask a knowledge test question with the Nixflex API. Ask a simulated question using current knowledge and return supplied-piece evidence.
pages.searchPhrase: ask a knowledge test question Nixflex API

pages.title: Cancel knowledge test
pages.description: Cancel knowledge test with the Nixflex API. Cancel a simulated test session and related unfinished work.

pages.title: Get knowledge job
pages.description: Get knowledge job with the Nixflex API. Poll authoritative job state, progress, result and safe failure details.

pages.title: Retry knowledge job
pages.description: Retry knowledge job with the Nixflex API. Retry a failed job when its revision and attempt limit still permit it.

pages.title: Cancel knowledge job
pages.description: Cancel knowledge job with the Nixflex API. Cancel pending work before installation while keeping published knowledge.

pages.title: Create knowledge export
pages.description: Create knowledge export with the Nixflex API. Queue a private export of accepted knowledge and settings.

pages.title: Download knowledge export
pages.description: Download knowledge export with the Nixflex API. Download a ready private export as structured JSON or readable text.

pages.title: Delete agent knowledge
pages.description: Delete agent knowledge with the Nixflex API. Revoke an agent’s live knowledge immediately and queue private-data deletion.

pages.title: Read web agent settings
pages.description: Read web agent settings with the Nixflex API. Read website agent settings for one owned number, including its current revision and optional appearance.
pages.searchPhrase: read web agent settings Nixflex API

pages.title: Update web agent settings
pages.description: Update web agent settings with the Nixflex API. Update website agent settings for one owned number using its current revision. A stale revision is refused.
pages.searchPhrase: update web agent settings Nixflex API

pages.title: Check inbox availability
pages.description: Check whether the Nixflex agent inbox is enabled in this environment. The feature check remains available when other inbox operations are disabled.

pages.title: List inbox numbers
pages.description: List owned numbers available to the Nixflex inbox and their active agent labels. Pending number imports are excluded from the list.

pages.title: List inbox conversations
pages.description: List inbox conversations with the Nixflex API. List conversations for one owned number and channel. Read-only listing does not mark messages as read.

pages.title: Read an inbox thread
pages.description: Read retained messages in one owned Nixflex inbox thread. The newest page is selected first, with its messages returned in chronological order.
pages.searchPhrase: read an inbox thread Nixflex API

pages.title: Update an inbox thread
pages.description: Update a Nixflex inbox thread's archive state or acknowledge messages through a known read version. Listing messages alone does not mark them read.
pages.searchPhrase: update an inbox thread Nixflex API

pages.title: Read inbox retention
pages.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default and inbox cleanup availability. Include a number to resolve retention for its assigned agent.

pages.title: Delete caller context
pages.description: Delete the complete Nixflex caller-context record for one caller on an owned business number. Review the record's scope before removing it.

pages.title: Get caller context
pages.description: Read saved Nixflex caller context for one caller and owned business number. Handle a missing record without inventing previous caller details.

pages.title: Set caller context
pages.description: Set supplied Nixflex caller context for one caller on an owned business number. Review saved-field behaviour and the response before retrying.

pages.title: Import caller context
pages.description: Import caller context for an owned Nixflex business number. Each row merges supplied customer context into the caller's existing record.

pages.title: Preview contact hours
pages.description: Preview recipient-local Nixflex contact windows without sending calls or SMS. Treat the result as advisory and recheck policy at dispatch.

pages.title: List contact suppressions
pages.description: List stored Nixflex do-not-contact entries in a channel bucket. Understand the all-channel bucket and how it differs from a combined list.

pages.title: Add contact suppressions
pages.description: Add Nixflex do-not-contact entries for future contact checks. Existing entries are retained; review the number, channel and suppression reason.

pages.title: Remove a contact suppression
pages.description: Remove one explicitly removable, owner-created Nixflex suppression. Recipient opt-outs and entries without removal permission remain protected.
pages.searchPhrase: remove a contact suppression Nixflex API

pages.title: Get Cal.com settings
pages.description: Get Cal.com settings with the Nixflex API. Read the saved Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

pages.title: Set Cal.com settings
pages.description: Set Cal.com settings with the Nixflex API. Save Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration.

pages.title: Delete Cal.com settings
pages.description: Remove saved Cal.com settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

pages.title: Get Slack settings
pages.description: Get Slack settings with the Nixflex API. Read the saved Slack settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

pages.title: Set Slack settings
pages.description: Replace saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.

pages.title: Delete Slack settings
pages.description: Remove saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

pages.title: Get Zapier settings
pages.description: Get Zapier settings with the Nixflex API. Read the saved Zapier settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

pages.title: Set Zapier settings
pages.description: Set Zapier settings with the Nixflex API. Save Zapier settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration.

pages.title: Delete Zapier settings
pages.description: Remove saved Zapier settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

pages.title: Get Make settings
pages.description: Get Make settings with the Nixflex API. Read the saved Make settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

pages.title: Set Make settings
pages.description: Replace saved Make settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.

pages.title: Delete Make settings
pages.description: Delete Make settings with the Nixflex API. Remove the saved Make configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number.

pages.title: Get GoHighLevel settings
pages.description: Read saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Configuration flags indicate secret presence without returning secret values.

pages.title: Set GoHighLevel settings
pages.description: Replace saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration for this integration.

pages.title: Delete GoHighLevel settings
pages.description: Remove saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

pages.title: Get pre-call gate for number
pages.description: Read the pre-call gate for an owned Nixflex number. A saved number-specific gate overrides the default from its assigned agent.
pages.searchPhrase: get pre-call gate for number Nixflex API

pages.title: Get pre-call gate for agent
pages.description: Read an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
pages.searchPhrase: get pre-call gate for agent Nixflex API

pages.title: Set pre-call gate for number
pages.description: Set pre-call gate for number with the Nixflex API. Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default.
pages.searchPhrase: set pre-call gate for number Nixflex API

pages.title: Set pre-call gate for agent
pages.description: Set an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
pages.searchPhrase: set pre-call gate for agent Nixflex API

pages.title: Clear pre-call gate for number
pages.description: Clear a saved number-specific Nixflex pre-call gate. Review the assigned agent's default when deciding the number's resulting gate behaviour.
pages.searchPhrase: clear pre-call gate for number Nixflex API

pages.title: Clear pre-call gate for agent
pages.description: Clear pre-call gate for agent with the Nixflex API. Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent.
pages.searchPhrase: clear pre-call gate for agent Nixflex API

pages.title: List custom functions
pages.description: List up to 15 saved custom functions for an owned Nixflex number. An empty list means no matching functions are saved for that account and number.

pages.title: Create a custom function
pages.description: Create a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Each number allows up to 15 functions with names unique within that number.
pages.searchPhrase: create a custom function Nixflex API

pages.title: Update a custom function
pages.description: Update selected fields of a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted fields keep their saved values.
pages.searchPhrase: update a custom function Nixflex API

pages.title: Delete a custom function
pages.description: Delete one custom function by its account, Nixflex number and function ID. Review the response and missing-function behaviour before retrying.
pages.searchPhrase: delete a custom function Nixflex API

pages.title: Get first webhook
pages.description: Read the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Primary and secondary slots are configured independently.

pages.title: Get second webhook
pages.description: Read the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Secondary and primary slots are configured independently.

pages.title: Set first webhook
pages.description: Set the primary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.

pages.title: Set second webhook
pages.description: Set the secondary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.

pages.title: Clear first webhook
pages.description: Clear the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the primary slot independently of the secondary slot.

pages.title: Clear second webhook
pages.description: Clear the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the secondary slot independently of the primary slot.

pages.title: Get web calls
pages.description: Get web calls with the Nixflex API. Read the saved web calls setting for an owned number. This controls the saved number switch for website voice calls.

pages.title: Set web calls
pages.description: Set the website voice-call switch for an owned Nixflex number. Review its saved state without starting a web call.

pages.title: Clear web calls
pages.description: Clear web calls with the Nixflex API. Clear the saved web calls setting for an owned number. This controls the saved number switch for website voice calls.

pages.title: Organisation roles and permissions
pages.description: Compare Owner, Admin and Member permissions in Nixflex. Keep server-side API key authority separate from personal dashboard sessions and membership checks.
pages.searchPhrase: organisation roles and permissions Nixflex API

pages.title: Get organisation context
pages.description: Read the Nixflex organisation selected by the authenticated credential, including its current permissions and account context.

pages.title: List organisation members
pages.description: List Nixflex organisation members, up to 100 pending or expired invitations, and current safety limits. Review role permissions before changes.

pages.title: List organisation activity
pages.description: Read Nixflex organisation activity, newest first, with up to 50 events per JSON page. Check role permissions and paging rules.

pages.title: Request an owner claim
pages.description: Invite a verified recipient to claim an existing, unclaimed Nixflex API-only account. Sending the invitation does not complete the claim.
pages.searchPhrase: request an owner claim Nixflex API

pages.title: Invite a teammate

pages.title: Resend a team invitation
pages.description: Replace a Nixflex team invitation with a new ID and 24-hour link. The previous link becomes invalid and sending limits still apply.

pages.title: Revoke a team invitation
pages.description: Revoke a pending or expired Nixflex invitation before acceptance. The link becomes invalid; this does not remove an existing team member.

pages.title: Change an organisation role
pages.description: Change a non-Owner Nixflex member to Admin or Member using Owner authority. Review the resulting permissions before saving the role.

pages.title: Remove an organisation member
pages.description: Remove one non-Owner member from a Nixflex organisation. Shared work and the shared API key remain; review any separate access that also needs removal.
pages.searchPhrase: remove an organisation member Nixflex API

pages.title: Rename an organisation
pages.description: Rename a Nixflex organisation using its API key or the Owner's personal session. Set the business name shown for that organisation.

pages.title: Get the signing secret
pages.description: Privately retrieve the Nixflex organisation signing secret to verify event deliveries. Keep it server-side and out of logs, browsers and shared output.

pages.title: Create an API account
pages.description: Create a separate Nixflex API-only account and its credential. This does not add another key to an existing account.

pages.title: Rotate the API key

pages.title: Get account usage

pages.title: Get account retention
pages.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default for new agents. Existing agents retain their saved settings until explicitly updated.

pages.title: Get key activity
pages.description: Read a snapshot of retained Nixflex API request activity for the account. Distinguish request logs from call history and billing usage.

pages.title: List voices
pages.description: List voices visible to the Nixflex account. Check compatibility for the optional agent context before choosing a voice.

pages.title: Get a voice
pages.description: Read a voice visible to the Nixflex account and its compatibility with an optional agent language. A successful read does not guarantee compatibility.

pages.description: Connect Google Calendar to an owned Nixflex number. Create a consent link, handle return codes and keep OAuth credentials private.

pages.title: Get Google Calendar status
pages.description: Read the Google Calendar connection for an owned Nixflex number, including reconnect state and whether caller invitations are enabled.
pages.searchPhrase: get google calendar status Nixflex API

pages.title: Disconnect Google Calendar
pages.description: Disconnect Google Calendar from an owned Nixflex number. Remove local access and understand in-flight bookings and shared Google grants.

pages.title: Update Google Calendar settings
pages.description: Set calendar timezone, weekly hours, slot length and caller invitations for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted settings retain their saved value.
pages.searchPhrase: update google calendar settings Nixflex API

pages.title: Update phone number credentials
pages.description: Update carrier credentials for an imported Nixflex phone number in place. Preserve settings and handle uncertain routing or credential saves safely.
pages.searchPhrase: update phone number credentials Nixflex API

pages.title: call.bookings: final booking results after a call
pages.description: Receive confirmed Nixflex booking actions and their final results after a call. Verify signatures, count active bookings and handle duplicate deliveries.
